name: limits
description: Numeric limits and constants. Provides minimum and maximum values for numeric types.

constants.name: F64Epsilon
constants.description: Machine epsilon for f64 (smallest x such that 1.0 + x != 1.0).

constants.name: I16Max
constants.description: Maximum value for 16-bit signed integer (C: int16_t).

constants.name: I16Min
constants.description: Minimum value for 16-bit signed integer (C: int16_t).

constants.name: I32Max
constants.description: Maximum value for 32-bit signed integer (C: int32_t).

constants.name: I32Min
constants.description: Minimum value for 32-bit signed integer (C: int32_t).

constants.name: I64Max
constants.description: Maximum value for i64 (Quadrate's native integer type).

constants.name: I64Min
constants.description: Minimum value for i64 (Quadrate's native integer type).

constants.name: I8Max
constants.description: Maximum value for 8-bit signed integer (C: int8_t).

constants.name: I8Min
constants.description: Minimum value for 8-bit signed integer (C: int8_t).

constants.name: U16Max
constants.description: Maximum value for 16-bit unsigned integer (C: uint16_t).

constants.name: U32Max
constants.description: Maximum value for 32-bit unsigned integer (C: uint32_t).

constants.name: U8Max
constants.description: Maximum value for 8-bit unsigned integer (C: uint8_t).
